root_cause_details: The direct script test used /tmp/vf-scripts from abstract Runtime. The actual pinned SubprocessRuntime overrides scripts_dir to its per-user CACHE_DIR/runtimes/scripts, so its child retained the orchestrator role. The explicit process_env fix also covers uv preparation and interpreter discovery.
next_decision: isolate runtime child role before uv sync/interpreter discovery/final script; prove actual complete uv launch path before GPU model loading
